text:
While the plants are not yet completely pas the shock of transplanting, we believe their survival rates will be over 80 per cent for Panax, 100 per cent for Lysimachia, 75 per cent for Lysodium, over 90 per cent for Gaultheria, and 50-60 per cent for Fothersilla.
C. Leland Rodgers
July 12, 1974
